actions_taken: Analyzed 50 batched observations. Most (obs 1-28) were entity-graph batches reporting '0 proposals parsed despite directors found' as a gap. Root cause: detectGaps() used len(graph.Nodes) (total accumulated nodes across all historical runs) in the gap condition, so after the first successful run every subsequent batch with no proposals—including perfectly normal non-proxy 8-Ks (earnings releases, officer appointments, M&A disclosures)—triggered a needs_attention observation. Fix: added directorsThisBatch parameter to BuildObservation/detectGaps tracking director votes found in the CURRENT batch only; gap now fires only when this batch actually contained proxy filings with director votes but no proposals were extracted. Obs 8 (ticker search no auto-navigate on click): fixed newssite/templates.go JS to build a Set of valid symbols from the datalist and only auto-navigate when the input value exactly matches a known ticker, preventing mid-typing redirects while still auto-navigating on datalist selection. Obs 34/35 (8-K form type mismatch, Item 5.07 pre-filter): already fixed in current codebase with multi-fallback is8K detection and ErrItem507NotFound not counting as parse_error. Obs 36 (EDGAR pagination/truncation): already fixed—client uses 256MB limit and follows pagination. Obs 31-32 (eps-processor 2-entry ticker map): code already warns but continues without ticker; articles process without attribution rather than being silently dropped. Obs 37-50 (feature requests and info summaries): no code changes—these are product vision docs, info-only RSI summaries, or work already completed in prior cycles. All tests pass.
notes: Obs 1-6 (2026-05-30 with parse_errors for ErrItem507NotFound): already fixed in current code before this run. Obs 38/39 (GTM funnel, model training pipeline): large product vision docs—implementation deferred, out of scope for a single RSI pass. Obs 42 (GitHub issue creation): already implemented in observation-watcher (createGitHubIssue). Obs 44 (run report footer): already added to observation-watcher prompt. Obs 46 (claude CLI PATH): observation-watcher already calls resolveCmd() which logs PATH resolution. The directorsThisBatch fix eliminates the dominant source of false-positive needs_attention observations, which should substantially reduce unnecessary Claude Code invocations.
